additions.note: Distinct lightweight video model with text/image inputs, 1–15-second clips, and native audio; available through Vercel AI Gateway. Date records primary Gateway announcement, not proven first release: earlier hosted evidence includes an October 1 Venice community post and October 4 Leap availability.
Frontier model for personal and professional agents, memory, and coding, with Active Memory and Active Focus; available through Meta Model API and Muse Code.
Companion frontier model in the Muse Wonder series for sustained agentic work and coding; available to Muse Code subscribers.
Accelerated 7B image generation and editing model using eight denoising steps; public weights under Qwen Research License and hosted Turbo API access.

Post-trained Qwen3.5-9B decision model returning calibrated probabilities for predefined yes/no, multiple-choice, rating, and grading options in one pass; available through Microsoft Foundry and OpenRouter.

Open-weight decision model based on Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct, accepting text, images, audio, and synchronized video and returning schema-bound probabilities; available through Workers AI and public weights.

Hosted diffusion decision model accepting text, JSON, and images and returning probabilities for yes/no, choice, and ordered-score questions with an optional explanation; available through the Celeris API.

Apache-2.0 12B MoE coding model with 2.5B active parameters and 131K context, trained for repository editing, tool use, and reasoning. Public BF16 weights; GGUF and MTP head were forthcoming at launch.
Conversation-tuned October snapshot for ChatGPT paid plans, with Intelligent UI and faster first responses; distinct from the September Sol version in Codex and Work.
Conversation-tuned October snapshot for ChatGPT Free and Go, distinct from the September Luna version in Codex and Work. Uses October 7 announcement date; rollout began October 8.

Byte-level adaptations of Qwen3-8B and Llama 3 8B, with final Bwen-8B and Llama-3-Blama-8B weights plus Stage1 checkpoints that freeze the global model while training byte components. Uses October 7 release announcement; earlier repository timestamps do not establish first public visibility.

Hosted text-only reasoning preview for coding and long-context analysis, with 256K context, streaming, and function calling; free during stealth for Vercel Pro/Enterprise teams with purchased Gateway credits. Developer identity undisclosed.

Hosted coding and agentic reasoning preview distributed by Nous Portal, free temporarily, with text-only 262K context, tools, structured outputs, and mandatory reasoning. October 10 announcement date; developer identity undisclosed.

Diffusion language model tuned for real-time voice-agent reasoning and tool use, with 128K context and 50K output; enterprise GA through the OpenAI-compatible Inception API. Serves the language-model stage of a speech pipeline.

Hosted structured decision model returning calibrated probabilities for choice, score, and Boolean questions, with 65K context; API access and free OpenRouter route. Date follows official distributor release record.

Hosted System One decision model based on Solar Mini4, with 512K context and choice, score, and Boolean probabilities in one forward pass; available through Upstage Console. Uses primary September 22 release date.
Music generation with improved layering, coherent songs, and natural instruments; hosted through ElevenMusic, ElevenCreative, and API.

Image creation and editing model with dense layouts, local edits, layer separation, multi-reference fusion, and multilingual text; already accessible through Volcano Ark experience center at announcement, with Doubao and Jimeng rollout upcoming.
7B model based on Falcon-H1-Arabic specialized for Emirati dialect and cultural context; available through Falcon Chat.
1.6B speech recognition model for Emirati and Standard Arabic, English, French, Spanish, and Portuguese, with word timestamps; official catalog offers a public hosted demo.
Compact 270M Arabic OCR and document model extracting text and structured information from images; available through an official hosted demo.

Generally available real-time speech-to-speech model with improved reasoning, instruction following, and tool accuracy, seven spoken languages, asynchronous tool calls, and 256K context; available through Amazon Bedrock.

Hosted decision model returning probabilities for text and image questions in one pass; vision available through Liquid Console and Playground, with partner routes text-only at launch. Distinct from October 7 edge weights.
Apache-2.0 German-English reasoning and tool-use MoE with 78.1B total and 3.46B active parameters, native 262K context and extrapolation to 1M; public FP8 weights.
Open-weight Qwen3-8B adaptation producing cited scientific reports from a question and retrieved literature in one pass; available as Asta Fast mode and downloadable weights.
Hosted Generalized Lightweight Decision Engine returning a selected action, confidence, and option probabilities, with additional reasoning for uncertain decisions; available through the Fastino API.

Apache-2.0 144.3M decision model adapted from mmBERT-small, scoring caller-defined choices and rubrics on CPU; public weights and ONNX/WebGPU export. Date follows contemporaneous launch coverage; first public weights visibility is unconfirmed and hosted API was not open at launch.

MIT-licensed roughly 1.9B typed decision checkpoint returning probabilities for predefined choices in one forward pass, improving composed decisions and negatively phrased policy rules; public weights and code. Uses publisher announcement date, not repository creation date.

Open-weight security deployment model derived from GLM-5.3 through expert pruning and W4A16 compression to 328 GB; public weights under the parent license. Initial compressed derivative, with security fine-tuning described as future work.
Realtime full-duplex voice interaction, ASR transcription, TTS synthesis, Gen audio generation, and Music song generation family; hosted access through StepFun API and Voice AI Lab.
Real-time multilingual speech perception model with streaming transcription, endpointing, and diarization for more than 20 speakers; available through Meta Model API, Meta AI for Mac, and Muse Code.
Native audio/video full-duplex conversation model with proactive perception and conversational timing; official launch describes full rollout.

Sub-1B multilingual document VLM for OCR, bounding boxes, semantic classes, chart-to-table parsing, and handwriting; public NVIDIA Open Model licensed weights. Uses NGC card's August 3 Hugging Face release date.

Audio/video creation with 30-second single-pass clips, repeated extension, multimodal references, and timestamp editing; accessible at launch on Jimeng AI and Doubao Pro, with API access announced for later.
Speech-to-speech model with improved speech reasoning, transcription, conversation, and tool use; available as grok-voice-think-fast-2.0 through the API.

0.6B multilingual listwise reranker with hybrid attention, self-distillation, and 131K context; hosted API and noncommercial downloadable weights. Uses July 27 catalog release date; explanatory announcement followed August 3.
Hosted unified scene audio generation including speech, sound effects, and ambience; available through BytePlus at launch.

Music generation model dated by provider release log; hosted MiniMax Audio access and public Music3 weights. New paid API subscriptions stopped August 20 while existing users retained access; weights publication date not established.
Model trained for agentic coding, web development, debugging, and MCP; early access May 19 per API release notes, followed by public API beta May 29.
Formal ERNIE 5.1 release, distinct from the earlier preview event; available through ernie.baidu.com and AI Studio Playground.
Speech-to-speech voice model that reasons while speaking; available through the Speech to Speech API as grok-voice-think-fast-1.0.
Tool-calling model with 2M context and long-horizon agent training; released in reasoning and non-reasoning API variants.
Fast, economical reasoning model for agentic coding, generally available through the xAI API.
